customers_say: Customers find the water purifier excellent in quality and appreciate its taste, with one mentioning the ability to adjust it. The product is easy to use and provides good water quality, with one customer noting a substantial improvement in filtration. However, durability is a concern as filters break within 6 months, and there are issues with leakage, with water continuously leaking out. Moreover, reliability and service receive mixed feedback, with some reporting excellent working performance while others say it stops working, and some praising quick customer care while others report bad service.
